### Summary of V3 Repairs and Empirical Results

1. **Full-Cohort Region-Eligibility Census & Scaling Benchmark ([v3_full.sbatch](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h4_structure/scripts/v3_full.sbatch), Slurm Job `53704591`, [h4_v3_53704591.out](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h4_structure/logs/h4_v3_53704591.out))**:
   - Completed outcome-independent physical cropping across all **$N = 5,851$ parent models**, producing **$7,773$ cropped confident region PDBs** across $5,690$ region-eligible models and identifying **$161$ `NO_CONFIDENT_REGION` models ($2.75\%$)** ([v3_full5851_cropped_regions_manifest.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h4_structure/results/v3_full5851_cropped_regions_manifest.tsv)).
   - Empirically established on 16 CPUs (`cn506-11-l`) that `foldseek easy-search --alignment-type 1 -e 10 -s 9.5 --max-seqs 1000` passes a mean of $990$ (median $1,000$) sequences per query ($5.79 \times 10^6$ whole-chain pairs) into 3D `tmalign`, progressing $9 / 65$ ($13.85\%$) in $702\text{ s}$ ($84.5\text{ min}$ projected for whole-chain `tmalign` alone and $\sim 183\text{ min}$ [$3.05\text{ h}$] for combined whole-chain + cropped searches), exceeding the $\le 16\text{ CPU}, \le 64\text{ GB}, \le 1\text{ h}$ single-job constraint.

2. **Repaired Stratified Pilot (`--max-seqs 1000`, Same-Run Whole-Chain + Cropped) & Horvitz–Thompson Design Weighting ([v3_pilot.sbatch](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h4_structure/scripts/v3_pilot.sbatch), Slurm Job `53706771`, [h4_v3_53706771.out](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h4_structure/logs/h4_v3_53706771.out))**:
   - **C1 (Control Hit-List Saturation Eliminated)**: Increasing `--max-seqs` from $50$ to $1000$ reduced `POST_EXCLUSION_EMPTY` across the $103$ control regions from $17$ (Tier 2), $22$ (Tier 3), and $27$ (Tier 4) in V2 to **$0 / 103$ ($0.00\%$) across all five tiers (Tiers 0–4)** in V3, rescuing $2$, $19$, $23$, and $31$ control regions at Tiers 1, 2, 3, and 4 ([v3_recovery_summary.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h4_structure/results/v3_recovery_summary.json)). Control match rates at `--max-seqs 1000` are **$74 / 75$ ($98.67\%$)** at the parent-model level ($102 / 103 = 99.03\%$ of regions) at Tiers 1–2 and **$73 / 75$ ($97.33\%$)** at the parent-model level ($101 / 103 = 98.06\%$ of regions) at Tiers 3–4 (`SeqId < 25%` and `< 20%`).
   - **C2 (`NO_CONFIDENT_REGION` vs `RAW_ZERO_RETRIEVAL`)**: Explicitly separates `NO_CONFIDENT_REGION` ($3$ in `K_local_pdb`, $4$ in `K_dual_none`, $4$ in `Q_not_K_pdb`) from true Foldseek `RAW_ZERO_RETRIEVAL` ($1$ in `K_local_pdb`, $10$ in `K_dual_none`, $0$ in `Q_not_K`, $1$ in `Controls`).
   - **C3 & C4 (Symmetric Whole-Chain/Cropped Tiers, Reference-Consistent Strata, and Horvitz–Thompson Estimators)**:
     - **`K_local_pdb` ($N = 849, n = 90$)**: Overall cropped match rate is **$83.72\% \pm 4.28\%$ H–T weighted** (95% CI $[75.33\%, 92.11\%]$; unweighted $75 / 90 = 83.33\%$; region-eligible $86.60\%$ H–T weighted / $75 / 87 = 86.21\%$ unweighted). Among the $81 / 90$ models that remain whole-chain unmatched ($qTM_{wc} < 0.5$) even at `--max-seqs 1000`, **$67 / 81$ ($83.04\% \pm 4.58\%$ H–T weighted, 95% CI $[74.06\%, 92.02\%]$; $82.72\%$ unweighted)** recover a structural match ($qTM_{crop} \ge 0.5$) after cropping.
     - **`K_dual_none` ($N = 95, n = 50$)**: Cropped recovery is **$36.00\% \pm 4.72\%$ H–T weighted** (95% CI $[26.75\%, 45.25\%]$; $18 / 50 = 36.00\%$ unweighted; $18 / 46 = 39.13\%$ region-eligible), with $18 / 50$ ($36.00\%$) `PERSISTENT_LOW_SCORE`, $10 / 50$ ($20.00\%$) `RAW_ZERO_RETRIEVAL`, and $4 / 50$ ($8.00\%$) `NO_CONFIDENT_REGION`.
     - **Primary Contrast (`K_local_pdb` vs `K_dual_none`)**: $+47.72$ percentage points H–T weighted ($83.72\%$ vs $36.00\%$, FPC $z = 7.49$, two-sided $p = 6.91 \times 10^{-14}$; unweighted Fisher's exact $p = 2.35 \times 10^{-8}$), and $+47.04$ percentage points among whole-chain-unmatched models at `--max-seqs 1000` ($83.04\%$ vs $36.00\%$ H–T weighted, $z = 7.15$, $p = 8.53 \times 10^{-13}$).
     - **`Q_not_K_pdb` ($N = 1,107, n = 55$)**: $55 / 55$ ($100.0\%$) match on the whole chain at `--max-seqs 1000$; **$51 / 51$ ($100.0\%$) of region-eligible models retain their match in cropped regions**, and the only $4 / 55$ ($7.27\%$) models losing their match upon cropping are the $4$ models with `NO_CONFIDENT_REGION`.
   - **C5 (Exact CIGAR Aligned Pairs, Repaired Paired McNemar Test, Retrieved-Only `fident`)**:
     - Validated `cigar_M == qspan + tspan - alnlen` on 100% of $115,916$ whole-chain hit rows and $129,914$ cropped hit rows (`96.44%` and `93.48%` of rows have query insertions opposite target gaps where `qspan > aligned_pairs`), reporting both `aligned_pair_qcov` and `qspan_cov` across all strata ([v3_region_evaluations.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h4_structure/results/v3_region_evaluations.tsv), [v3_model_summaries.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h4_structure/results/v3_model_summaries.tsv)).
     - Repaired the $3,013$-control paired self-hit exclusion test ($117 / 3,013 \to 159 / 3,013$, paired discordant counts $b = 0, c = 42$, exact two-sided McNemar binomial $p = 4.55 \times 10^{-13}$) and reported retrieved-only sequence identity distributions alongside exact counts of candidate hits with `fident >= 20%`.
